score_definition.class_policy: scene GT-present classes only, equal class weight
score_definition.pooling: Accumulate each scene pixel confusion matrix first; never mean per-image IoU

interpretation: Historical framework maxima use complete5004 S only; hard1500 and validation scores never enter that ranking.
Historical highest tested checkpoint and final validation-selected checkpoint are distinct. Repeatedly inspected local test scores are not untouched holdout estimates or official-platform rankings.
New hard1500 validation participates in checkpoint selection; old-model hard1500 is diagnostic. Neither is comparable directly to complete5004 S or old1601 validation.
Historical periodic snapshots with S<=0.92 were automatically removed under the prior retention rule. Metrics and hashes survive; no claim that absent exact weights remain loadable.
PureViT full5004 is only epoch5 while training continues; it is not the final architecture upper bound.
